data.body:
Round-4 correction pass (2026-08-22), after a session was killed mid-flight by an auth failure. Ignore the stray 'ping' comment above (tracker-push smoke test).

Description corrections made against the tree, not narration:
- `artifact_emit.py:84` was unresolvable as written — the file is `src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py` (line 84 builds `code-review: {change_id} @ {revision}`), not under `llm/code_review/`. Qualified.
- The round-3 comment recorded that '_assemble_code_review_run is the only site holding session_id/change_id' had been REFUTED, but the description still carried the refuted claim. Now reworded: `_assemble` is where the workflow INPUTS are built, `finalize.py` holds the same ids, and both share ONE rule via the new `sidecar.memory_key`.
- `rising_floor_drop` (`:105`) was ambiguous between the two files named nearby; it is `review_kernel/decide.py:105`. Qualified.
- Every other citation was re-verified against origin/main and holds exactly: region_gate.py:31, sidecar.py:354, workflow_ops.py:237/:270/:641, decide.py:631, registry.py:535, verify.py:114/:435, plan_review/passes.py:66, plan_review/sidecar.py:396/:414, pass1.py:489, adapter.py:122, finding_publish.py:126/:147. workflow_ops.py is 758 LOC on main as stated.
- file_impact replaced: the recorded array still listed `code-review-verifier.md` and `tests/unit/llm/code_review/test_finding_carry_forward.py`, neither of which exists. It now names the 14 paths actually touched.
- Description trimmed to 7868 chars for the 8000-char P4 admission cap.

Test-quality correction: `test_ineligible_dropped_bucket_is_never_carried` was a tautology — it stubbed the reader with a hand-built union of two empty buckets, so it asserted nothing about the reader. Rewritten to run end-to-end through the REAL `latest_code_review_result` (store layer stubbed at `_latest_payload_with_ts` / `list_tickets`) against a payload whose finding sits in the `dropped` bucket, and it now dies when the reader's union is widened to include `dropped`.
